blocks.text: SecurityScorecard is an information security company that rates the cybersecurity postures of companies via scored analysis of cyber threat intelligence signals for third-party management and IT risk management.
For the SecurityScorecard Alerts stream, see Configuring the SecurityScorecard Alerts Connector.
To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and SecurityScorecard Deployment Guide.
To configure the SecurityScorecard connector, you need the source authentication configuration.
To create the SecurityScorecard data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the SecurityScorecard data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Security Scorecard Authentication window appears.
In the Security Scorecard Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
